comment: BastlPizza publishes no source. Three of the thirteen parameters sit at the DELAY knob and three more at the SPACE knob: only the one the current mode calls for is visible, so each has its own line. Basil is the only module in this plugin that reads more than channel 0: the left and right inputs each use their channels count as a loop bound and sum every channel into one mono signal, so a polyphonic cable is mixed rather than kept apart. The right input normals to the left. The SYNC threshold of 0.2V is unusually low for a clock input; the input is one-pole filtered first. The DELAY input is scaled two to the power of the voltage, but whether a positive voltage lengthens or shortens the delay was not traced past Interpolation::updateValue, so the line says only that it doubles per volt. The Character menu and the SPEED button set the same sample-rate division, which is why the menu names four steps where the button shows two lights.
